_comment: Build Planner: the private game offsets the plugin reads (read-only). The plugin reads this file from its data folder; an offsets.json in its config folder overrides any key after a game patch. Keys are the field names of bp::Offsets (src/core/Offsets.h); values are "0x..." hex strings or non-negative integers; keys starting with "_" are comments. Values for the PoE2 0.5.5 client of 2026-11-16.
_tree: Passive tree panel. UiRootStruct = the panel root the host gives (Ui.GetGameUiRoot).
_treePanelSlot: UiRootStruct: -> passive tree panel. A shortcut only: the panel must pass the structural test
_canvasChildIndex: tree panel child index of the pan/zoom canvas (shortcut; the canvas is found by its child count)
_rowGraphId: PassiveSkills row: u16 PassiveSkillGraphId (the Path of Building node id)
_rowIdString: PassiveSkills row: -> UTF-16 Id string (diagnostics only)
_nodeState: node element: u8 allocation: 0 allocated, 1 Weapon Set I, 2 Weapon Set II, 4 not allocated
_nodeKind: node element: u8 kind: 0 normal, 1 jewel socket, 3 mastery art, 4/7 hidden (optional)
_nodeAttrIcon: node element: -> attribute-choice texture object, 0 unless an allocated attribute node (optional)
_attrIconPath: attribute texture object: -> texture path string (plusstrength / plusdexterity / plusintelligence)
_nodeTooltipAttach: node element: -> array of {UiElement* tooltip, float2 anchor, u64} (diagnostics; read as uiElemTooltips)
_elemEffectiveScale: any UI element: float effective scale; on the canvas it must equal canvasRect.w / canvas.w
_character: Character passives: PSD -> passive allocation object, its fields, and the fallback scan ranges.
_serverDataSlot: UiRootStruct: -> ServerData (cross-check holder of the PSD)
_serverDataPsdVector: ServerData: std::vector<PSD*>; [0] must equal the PSD
_passiveObjAlias: PSD: holds the passive object + objSelfBias
_objSelfBias: the alias and objSelfA hold the object's address plus this
_objAllocated: passive object: std::vector<u32> allocated: low16 graph id (ascending), byte 2 weapon set 0/1/2
_objAttributes: passive object: std::vector<u32> attribute choices: low16 node id, high16 option id
_objGranted: passive object: std::vector<u16> nodes granted by items (not paid with points)
_objJewelSockets: passive object: std::vector of jewel socket records
_jewelSocketGraphId: jewel socket record: u16 graph id
_objQuestPoints: passive object: i32 passive points from quests
_objWeaponSetPoints: passive object: i32 weapon set points, the TOTAL per set
_objAscPointsA: passive object: i32 ascendancy points (total or spent; the order is not settled)
_objAscPointsB: passive object: i32 ascendancy points (the other one)
_psdScanFrom: fallback scan of UiRootStruct for the PSD slot: from
_psdScanTo: fallback scan of UiRootStruct for the PSD slot: to (exclusive)
_objScanFrom: fallback scan of the PSD for the passive object slot: from
_objScanTo: fallback scan of the PSD for the passive object slot: to (exclusive)
_vecScanFrom: fallback scan of the passive object for the allocated vector: from
_vecScanTo: fallback scan of the passive object for the allocated vector: to (exclusive)
_diagnostics: Shown in the Diagnostics card only; never compared (vtable RVAs change with every build of the game).
_nodeVtableRva: node element vtable RVA on the reference client (never compared)
_groupVtableRva: group container vtable RVA on the reference client (never compared)
_ascContainerVtableRva: ascendancy container vtable RVA on the reference client (never compared)
_passiveObjVtableRva: passive object vtable RVA on the reference client (never compared)
_hover: UI manager, hover and the game's tooltips (tooltip vectors confirmed for items, Skills panel sockets and passives).
_uiElemSelf: any UI element: self pointer (validates a hovered pointer)
_mgrRoot: UI manager: -> true UI root (must equal the parent of the panel root)
_mgrHovered: UI manager: -> element under the mouse (may be stale: validate)
_mgrMouseX: UI manager: i32 mouse x, client px
_mgrMouseY: UI manager: i32 mouse y, client px
_mgrTooltipOwner: UI manager: -> element whose item tooltip is shown, 0 none
_itemElTooltip: inventory item element: -> its tooltip element (ParentPtr == the item element)
_uiElemTooltips: any UI element: std::vector of its tooltips {UiElement* tooltip, float2 anchor, u64} (tooltip ParentPtr == the element)
_uiTooltipStride: tooltip vector entry size (the tooltip element pointer at +0)
_equipContainerChildIndex: inventory panel child index of the equipment container (shortcut)
_uiInventoryPtr: inventory-bound UI element: -> InventoryStruct (only valid on inventory elements)
_uiSlotCell: inventory-bound UI element: four u32 col, row, w, h of the slot inside its inventory
_invDatRow: InventoryStruct: u32 Inventories.dat row index (the reliable identity)
_invBoxes: InventoryStruct: two i32 TotalBoxes x, y
_invItems: InventoryStruct: std::vector<InventoryItemStruct*>, one entry per CELL (dedupe by pointer)
_invRequestCounter: InventoryStruct: i32 server request counter (moves when the inventory changes)
_invItemSlotStart: InventoryItemStruct: two i32 slot start x, y
_invItemSlotEnd: InventoryItemStruct: two i32 slot end x, y (exclusive)
_psdInventories: PSD: std::vector of player inventory records
_psdInventoryStride: player inventory record size: i32 id, pad, -> InventoryStruct, -> second struct
_invRowRing3: Inventories.dat row of Ring3 (the equipment row most likely to move with a patch)
_lookupBucketStride: component lookup bucket size: char* name, i32 index, pad
_socketsEntities: Sockets component: six entity pointers, 0 = empty socket
_socketsCounts: Sockets component: std::vector<u8>, size = socket count
_modsGrantedSkills: Mods component of an item: std::vector<Entity*> of the skill gems it grants
_skillGemLevel: SkillGem component: u32 the gem's own level
_invRowSkillSlots: Inventories.dat row of SkillSlots1 (the character's skill gems)
_skillsPanelSlot: UiRootStruct: -> Skills panel (shortcut: validated by the structural recipe)
_bigSocketRow: big socket element: u32 Inventories.dat row of the skill gem's inventory
_bigSocketSlot: big socket element: u32 slot x of the skill gem
_supSocketOwnerRow: support socket element: u32 owner gem's Inventories.dat row
_supSocketOwnerSlot: support socket element: u32 owner gem's slot x
_supSocketIndex: support socket element: u32 socket index 0..4
